recommendation.quote: Negotiate. Don’t accept this offer as-is, but don’t walk away before giving Google a chance to improve it.

equity_grounding.quote: Looking at the Google offer over the full four-year grant period—and not assuming discretionary refresh grants—the current package would represent a meaningful reduction in both base salary and average total compensation.
